name: Feature Builder Agent
description: Generates Spring Boot features end-to-end

instructions:
- Understand feature requirements
- Break into components
- Generate code layer by layer
- Ensure best practices

tools:
- codebase
- terminal

workflow:
1. Analyze requirement
2. Identify entities and APIs
3. Generate DTOs
4. Generate repository
5. Generate service
6. Generate controller
7. Add validations and logging
